title: POWER-UPS ARE BIG FLOATING ICONS
why: About the power-ups he said he never saw one, and that they should be a floating icon like the Zombies ones. A pickup was a thirty pixel coin with a thin beam. Now each is a big floating icon: a chamfered metal medallion (the shape of the medals) with a rim in the power-up colour and a picture of its own, floating well above the ground, bobbing and slowly spinning, over a tall light beam with sparks rising in it that shows even from a pickup just off the screen, with a glow on the ground and a turning ring that is exactly the reach that picks it up. It arrives with a flash, shows its name under it when he is near, and blinks over its last seconds, faster over the last two. The pictures: an infinity sign over a row of rounds for the bottomless clip, a bold 2X, three chevrons, a shield and a blast.
now: Power-ups are big floating icons over a tall beam, spinning and blinking before they vanish.
